BOBBY WORKBOOK TASK 3 (Sept 30). Bobby executes under Kevin. Goal: Claude reads the correct KMD GoHighLevel sub-account and performs a controlled, verified write.

Connect: (1) Confirm KMD's sub-account name and location ID; confirm the company Claude workspace admin has enabled connectors. (2) In Claude, Customize → Connectors, add the official HighLevel connector using the Anthropic endpoint https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/anthropic/v2 and start OAuth. (3) Authorize with the company HighLevel login; select only KMD's sub-account; allow read/edit for contacts and opportunities (calendar only if needed); do not grant payments, bulk deletion or messaging for a test.
Verify: (1) Inspect available tools; a search-only connector is not done. (2) Read test: retrieve the KMD location and a known test record; verify IDs. (3) Write test on a designated test contact with automations disabled: change a harmless field or tag, read it back, restore it; capture redacted evidence. (4) If OAuth fails, check workspace connector permissions and the HighLevel Anthropic guide; a Private Integration Token is a fallback only. (5) Record connection owner, location ID, enabled tools, test results, revocation steps; verify access for the intended team member.
Done when: Claude reads the correct KMD data and performs a verified reversible write; if blocked, report the exact missing permission and continue with insurance tasks.

AI PROMPT (copy into Claude):
"Help me connect the company Claude workspace to the KMD Analytical GoHighLevel sub-account using the current official HighLevel Anthropic MCP OAuth instructions. My Claude plan is [plan], my role is [role], and the visible connector options are [options]. Use https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/mcp/anthropic/v2. Explain one step at a time. Check the correct location, minimum read and edit scopes, available operations, and a reversible test that cannot send messages or trigger workflows. If authorization fails, identify the exact blocker and supported fallback. Do not ask me to paste tokens into chat or claim success without read-back evidence."
